about.title: Why Sofratak exists
about.p1: Sofratak started in Tampa, at the counter of family restaurants watching a quarter of every delivery order leave through an app. The owners worked the same hours; the apps kept more of the money every year.
about.p2: We build one thing: your own ordering site, with your name on it, where your food revenue settles to your bank and your customer list belongs to you. Flat monthly price. No commission. No lock-in.
about.p3: It's called Sofratak — «سفرتك», your table — because that's whose it is.
about.founder: Zizo (Ahmad Zeidan) — Offbeat Creative LLC, Tampa, Florida

assistant.fallback: Good question — I don't want to guess on that one. Message us on WhatsApp and a human (usually Zizo) will answer quickly, or book a 15-minute demo.

legal.privacyBody: Sofratak (Offbeat Creative LLC) collects the information you submit through our forms — name, phone, email, restaurant details — to respond to your inquiry and provide our service. Diner phone numbers collected at checkout are used for order updates, and for marketing only with explicit opt-in. We do not sell personal data. Restaurant data belongs to the restaurant and is exportable at any time. Payment card data is processed by Stripe and never touches our servers. Questions: contact us via the details in the footer.
legal.termsBody: Sofratak provides online ordering software to restaurants on a month-to-month subscription, per location. Restaurants are the merchant of record for their food sales; Sofratak charges diners a flat per-order service fee shown at checkout. Estimated-savings figures across this site are illustrative, based on information provided, and are not guarantees. Either party may cancel with effect at the end of the billing month; on cancellation the restaurant receives a complete export of its data. Service is provided as-is; our liability is limited to fees paid in the prior month.
